rule_source: cua_repl returned tool documentation, Computer Use section
exact_rule: Use cua_repl (JavaScript) for all UI actions. Do not use other technologies besides cua_repl for computer interactions, unless specifically requested by the user (e.g. AppleScript, osascript, JXA, System Events, CGEvent synthesis).
scope: All UI actions/computer interactions, including browser control exposed through this tool. No alternate controller was used.
